title.narrative: Environmentally sound management and disposal of Polychlorinated Biphenyls (PCBs)

description.narrative: The project aims to comply with the Stockholm Convention (SC), through implementation of the PCB-related action plans of the NIP including the necessary regulations and standards, strengthening of institutions at the national and local levels, enforcement, capacity building, and awareness raising among the stakeholders in order to manage PCB wastes in an environmentally sound manner.
